errors.text_span: steigt bis auf ungefähr 103 im Juli 2015
errors.evidence: The purple line remains at a value of 100 until January 2017. It does not rise in July 2015.
The purple line is a step function and increases in discrete steps, not gradually ('allmählich').

errors.text_span: und bleibt bis etwa Januar 2021 relativ stabil
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect as it misses a step increase in January 2020. The line is not stable for this entire period.

errors.text_span: die die Linie auf etwa 115 im Januar 2023 anheben
errors.evidence: In January 2023, the value of the purple line is approximately 141, not 115. The line reached a value of 115 in January 2022.
The purple line never falls; it only increases or stays constant.

errors.text_span: und erreicht im Juli 2025 den Wert 118,7
errors.evidence: The final value of the purple line in July 2025 is 150, not 118.7.
There are two blue lines (light blue and dark blue). This description is ambiguous and does not specify which one is being described.

errors.text_span: steigt bis auf etwa 104 im Juli 2015
errors.evidence: In July 2015, the light blue line has a value of approximately 101, not 104.
In January 2020, the value of the light blue line is closer to 114, not 112.

errors.text_span: Bis Januar 2022 steigt die Linie auf etwa 116
errors.evidence: In January 2022, the value of the light blue line is approximately 118, not 116.

errors.text_span: und bleibt bis Juli 2022 relativ stabil. Vom Juli 2022 bis zum Juli 2025 steigt die Linie ziemlich steil auf etwa 152 an.
errors.evidence: This description incorrectly merges two different lines. The light blue line continues to rise (not remain stable) until it ends in mid-2022. The subsequent steep rise belongs to the dark blue line, which is a separate data series with a different index base.

errors.text_span: Eine dritte Linie, die als "Tarifliche Stundenlöhne (ohne Sonderzahlungen), Index (Oktober 2022 = 141,2)" bezeichnet wird, beginnt bei einem Wert von etwa 116 im Januar 2022
errors.evidence: The dark blue line starts in July 2022 at a value of approximately 140, not in January 2022 at a value of 116. The description confuses this line with the light blue line.

errors.text_span: und steigt bis zu 141,2 im Oktober 2022.
errors.evidence: The line does not rise *to* 141.2 from a lower value. According to the legend and the visual data, 141.2 in October 2022 is the starting point (or a point very close to the start) of this index series.

errors.text_span: Von Oktober 2022 bis Juli 2025 steigt die Linie allmählich auf etwa 157 an.
errors.evidence: The dark blue line ends in January 2025, not July 2025. Its final value is approximately 155, not 157.
